Sensitive reports belong in [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Yivas/cotilleo-convo-pi/security/advisories/new), not here. Credentials, private conversations, prompts, personal paths and operational configuration must be removed.

## Change and motivation

Describe the coherent change, user need and related issue if one exists. Planned behavior must remain distinguishable from implemented behavior.

## Verification

List checks actually run and their results. Reading content and checking affected links is appropriate for current documentation. There is no plugin build or supported executable baseline yet; mark unperformed or inapplicable checks explicitly.

## Compatibility, risks and documentation

Describe affected contracts, permissions, privacy and documentation. State when no compatibility claim applies. A PR does not authorize installation or deployment.

## Confirmation

- [ ] I checked existing issues and the contribution guidance.
- [ ] I removed sensitive data and identified any third-party material and required notices.
- [ ] I described verification honestly and kept product status accurate.
